purpose: Establish comparable daily windows for closure, atomic debt, autonomy, recurrence internalization, receiver return, recovery, exemplar availability, latency and cost.

metric_definitions.verified_useful_closures: Count only work reaching a real receiver/use point with a receipt or independently verifiable effect.
metric_definitions.atomic_debt_created: New useful work stranded as isolated concepts/scripts/tests/files/handoffs lacking a closure path.
metric_definitions.recurring_needs_internalized: Recurring needs converted into reusable internal capabilities with trigger/receipt/recovery/retirement rules.
metric_definitions.external_dependencies: Material recurring needs still dependent on an external provider or manual external surface.
metric_definitions.human_relay_events: Material state transfer requiring Rick or another human to courier context between otherwise disconnected surfaces.
metric_definitions.independent_receiver_returns: Independent human or external-system responses that materially inform or challenge the work.
metric_definitions.x2_observer_availability: Fraction of the window the authorized remote observer is proven reachable; null if coverage is insufficient.
metric_definitions.source_to_successor_latency_hours: Measured hours from material source delta to accepted successor projection/capability when both timestamps are known.
metric_definitions.measured_cost: Known money/compute/human-time inputs for the window; incomplete fields remain null.
